main_text.p: delitatis speciminia exhibens, quæ tanta demùm fuit, ut eius instrumenta sævitiæ, omne ferrum consumptura viderentur:
----ⁱ[?] Vt timeas, ne Juvenal. Sat.3. Vomer deficiat, ne marra, & sarcula desint.

Sed in Christianos inprimis desæviit, nec illos è fæce plebis tenebriones; sed ipsos Episcopos, quasi eminentiores spicas primò amputavit. Eutropium Sentonensem, Lucianum Bellovacensem, Nicasium Rotomagensem, Cletum Romanum, Antipam Pergamensem, & denique Romulum Fesulanum, in Tuscia Episcopum. Inchoata verò à Christianæ Religionis Antistitibus persecutio, in Senatores & Consulares viros, eandem veritatem profitentes, tandem progressa, Civicum Cerealem in ipso Asiæ Proconsulatu interemit, Salvidienum, item Orsitum, & Acilium Glabvonem in exilio, quasi molitores novarum rerum, inquit Suetonius: quod ad Iudæos transfissent, ait Dio (quo nomine ab Ethnicis censebantur Christiani, quod & Christus, & eius Apostoli Iudæi ef-sent)

page.notes: Only the head of the page is visible in this part: running head and page number. The text block is blank here. The facing page is only partly visible at the far right, with a single letter at its running head, and is not transcribed. The first line of the verse carries a small raised mark before "Vt", read as ⁱ and uncertain. No note text is printed under the main text on this part of the page. The strip at the far right belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
